blind.description: An ornate standing floor candelabra crafted in gold/brass with deep red/maroon enameled accents. It features an ornate triangular tripod base resting on three paw-style feet, a turned baluster-style central column with gold and red banded decorative elements, and five candle holders (four radiating outward on curved scroll arms, and one raised central holder). Each holder carries a cream-colored dripping wax candle with an unlit wick. There are no flames or light glows.
blind.from_above: A central circle surrounded symmetrically by four circular candle holders in a cross formation, with the three-legged base visible underneath and a distinct shadow stretching upward.
defects: Tiny black wick particles are floating detached in mid-air above several of the candles
blind.height_vs_figure: About 60% of the figure's height (around 3.5 ft tall) and roughly 1.5 ft wide at the arms and base
